Test Case Title: Verify the Dynamic Button toggles between START and STOP
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Steps: 1. Read the button text (START) 2. Click the button 3. Verify it shows STOP 4. Click again 5. Verify it shows START
Expected Result: Button text alternates START -> STOP -> START

Test Case Title: Verify an item can be chosen from the Scrolling DropDown
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Steps: 1. Click the Scrolling DropDown field 2. Scroll the list to 'Item 25' 3. Click 'Item 25' 4. Read the field value
Expected Result: Field shows 'Item 25' and the list closes

Test Case Title: Verify lazy-loaded items appear while scrolling the Scrolling DropDown
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Steps: 1. Click the Scrolling DropDown field 2. Scroll to the bottom repeatedly until 'Item 150' is loaded 3. Click 'Item 150' 4. Read the field value
Test Data: Item: Item 150 (not in the first 100 loaded items)
Expected Result: More items load on scroll; field shows 'Item 150'

Test Case Title: Verify elements inside the Shadow DOM can be read and operated
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open

Test Case Title: Verify the Wikipedia search widget returns results
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open; internet access to Wikipedia is available
Test Steps: 1. Scroll to the 'Tabs' (Wikipedia) widget 2. Type a search term 3. Click the search button 4. Wait for the results 5. Count the result links
Expected Result: At least one search result is displayed
